title: Review: SSE warn log and try_send match pattern
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — The behavioral change is correct and the warn logging is a pure improvement. One P1 filed for missing structured log fields (no client identity in the stall warn). No security surface, no new public API, no lock-in.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) the close_after_first + Full arm breaks without sending None — I traced the stream termination path through ReceiverStream and take_while and concluded it terminates cleanly, but this depends on tokio's ReceiverStream behavior when the sender drops, which I did not verify against tokio source; (2) the test suite exercises closeafter=state paths but the Full arm (channel full) is not tested — it would require a test that enqueues 256 items before the close-signal send. Would raise confidence if: a test covering the Full arm on the close-signal path existed, and if I had confirmed tokio ReceiverStream behavior on sender-drop against the tokio docs or source.
